mapper.sql: PA.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO, PA.PERSON_ID, PA.EMPID, PA.LOCAL_NAME, PA.DEPTNO, GET_DEPT_NAME(PA.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PA.POST_FAMILY_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_FAMILY_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PA.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(PA.POSITION_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS POSITION_NAME, PA.INCOME_BEFORE_TAX, (PA.PERSONAL_INS_TOTAL + PA.PERSONAL_TAX + PA.P_AFTER_TAX_MINUS) AS WITHHOLD_TOTAL, PA.REAL_WAGES
mapper.select:
SELECT , NULL AS PAY_DATE, NULL AS PAY_DATE_FORMAT FROM PA_SUMMARY_HTSV PA WHERE PA.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PA.PAY_SCHEDULE_NO = #{payScheduleNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND (PA.EMPID LIKE '%' || #{empSearch, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%' OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(PA.LOCAL_NAME)) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{empSearch, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%' OR PA.ENGLISH_NAME LIKE '%' || #{empSearch, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT B1.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 WHERE B1.DEPTNO = PA.DEPTNO AND B1.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} START WITH B1.DEPTNO = #{deptNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO)
ORDER BY PA.EMPID

SELECT , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PA.PAY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'DD-MM-YYYY') AS PAY_DATE, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PA.PAY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS PAY_DATE_FORMAT FROM PA_SUMMARY_HTSV PA WHERE PA.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND PA.PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND SUBSTR(PA.PAY_DATE, 0, 7) BETWEEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{startMonth, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY-MM') AND TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{endMonth, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY PA.PAY_DATE
mapper.update: { CALL PA_FOR_MY_SALARY_DETAIL_PAGE_P( #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NULL, #{startMonth, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{endMonth, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '全体员工', TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{payDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD-MM-YYYY'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{itemType, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) }
